name: CSO_SUBSCRIPTION
description: List of documents a user is subscribed to.

columns.name: ACTIVE
columns.description: Flag indicating whether this subscription is active or not.

columns.name: CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: This is the channel id for this record.

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: This is the content id for this record.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: This is the datetime the subscription will end on.

columns.name: FORUM_ID
columns.description: This is the forum id for this record.

columns.name: LAST_CRAWL
columns.description: The last time this subscription was crawled.

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_BY
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID of the user that last modified the record.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: This is the user that last modified the record.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE
columns.description: This is the type of subscription this is.

columns.name: TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This is the topic id for this record.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: The obsolete GUID of the user to which this subscription belongs.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: The localeid only required if this is a content subscription.

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user that last modified the record.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: The ID of the user to which this subscription belongs.
